notes: The negative-oath אִם carries 'Surely none of': no other morpheme in the clause bears a negation, so none of the three words is added. Heading on 'none' as the negation word is the competing reading and is recorded in the unit note.

מִלְאוּ ... אַחֲרַי is split rather than fused: the suffix keeps 'me', so by rule 40's subtraction test the preposition's own relation alone goes unstated and it is unrepresented, exactly as in v. 12.
מַעְלָה is host plus directive he under one English word (rules 32, 30), and בֶּן takes the age idiom's 'old' discontinuously (rule 25).
